_comment: Copy to config.json next to this file (or mount it at /data/userbot/config.json). The session file it creates IS the account - keep both out of git and off shared storage.
_owner: Numeric Telegram user ids allowed to drive this. owner_id is the primary: the default answerer for a card, and the one it will not run without. owner_ids lists everyone else. Permissions are flat - all of them may dial on any card - but only one call runs at a time. Get the ids from @userinfobot; nothing else is obeyed.
_gateway: Control plane, used read-only to discover lines and their SIP parameters.
_cards: One entry per SIM. sip_user is an external SIP account created in the WebUI under SIM Config -> External SIP accounts; the dialplan already rings every external account on an incoming call. Usernames MUST differ between lines: they are all registered from one PJSUA2 endpoint, and two accounts sharing a sip:user@host identity make an inbound call ambiguous. answer_owner is the account rung when that SIM receives a call, 0 = the primary. Leave sip_password out: the gateway hands out each account's own password. A blank line means the first configured one.
_dial_allowlist: Optional. Empty = any number may be dialled. A compromised sidecar can place calls, so pin this down if the numbers you call are predictable.
